verdict.rationale: doola ships a Partner API, so a versioning and deprecation-policy story applies to it. The evidence pack covers sandbox keys, idempotency, error codes, webhooks and key management, but nothing on API version identifiers, version pinning, changelogs or a deprecation policy. Probes found no OpenAPI spec either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
